setting: You all live in the same market town in the English Midlands and belong to its one allotment society, which runs a single site on the edge of town. You know each other from society meetings and working parties, and this chat is used for planning the autumn working party, getting the shared water tap repaired, and arranging the compost delivery.
openers: Send a reminder about the autumn working party
Ask who can bring a tea urn on the day
Post a note that the shared tap is being fixed
Tell everyone the compost delivery is due Thursday
opener: Send a reminder about the autumn working party

private_lines.Derek: You live in the town, spend your days chairing the allotment society and volunteering as a hospital driver, and live alone.
private_lines.Denise: You live in the town, spend your days managing a care home and keeping the society's records as secretary, and live alone.
private_lines.Ryan: You live in the town, spend your days as an electrician and tending your plot, and live with your partner Zara.
private_lines.Zara: You live in the town, spend your days as a teaching assistant and tending your newer plot, and live with your partner Ryan.
private_lines.Irene: You live in the town, spend your days in retirement after a long career as a headmistress and tending your plot, and live alone.

text: Reminder: autumn working party is Saturday 5 December, nine o'clock at the main gate. Bring gloves and anything for the hedge. Tea and bacon rolls from the hut at half eleven as usual.
ok will be there. is the tap getting done before or after?
Plumber can come Wed morning if someone lets him in. Derek can you do it?
I'm on the Wednesday run to Stoke until about two. Ryan, you're nearer the tap than I am. Can you get in there?
i can be there before 8 wed but have to be at a job for 9. he can come before i go?
I'll text Dave the plumber. He said 7.30 is fine
Is the compost lorry still Thurs? I need abt 3 bags for the new bed
Thursday, yes. Between eight and twelve. Denise has the order form.
Form's in the office. Pay by cheque or bank transfer to the society account, not cash. Last year that was a nightmare
ok thx! will sort it tmrw Irene do you want me to put your name down for compost too?
job overran, now they've got me on the 18th too
Crazy morning at work one of ours has packed a suitcase and is waiting for the bus to Blackpool. Will catch up with the working party list tonight
Blackpool is a long walk. I hope someone catches her before the bus.
Hope she's safe. Denise, I need the list by Friday for the hut rota.
Yes please, Zara. Two bags if there is room. I shall want the black stuff, not the brown.
Dave confirmed Wed 7.30 Who has the key to the tap house? I think Irene still has the spare?
I have it in the drawer. I will bring it on Saturday.
the job in lichfield had a kettle wired into the bathroom light. dont ask
omg who does that
Sorry for the late reply. Long night at the Royal with a family. All fine now.
Hope it wasn't too bad x
It was not. Thank you.
List done. I'll send it to the society email in the morning
